clusterEnvironmentListBlock.title: Cluster Environment List 1
clusterEnvironmentListBlock.description: A filterable cluster-environment overview that combines critical, warning, normal, offline, and data-freshness states in one responsive card list.
clusterEnvironmentListBlock.guidanceBody: Provide environments from your monitoring model. Health drives the card state treatment, while freshness remains an independent state so a previously normal environment can still be marked as expired.
